class.name: Axle
class.brief_description: A vehicle axle that groups wheels and distributes drive forces.
class.description: Axle is a [Node3D] that serves as a grouping node for [Wheel] children. It computes suspension parameters for each wheel based on the vehicle mass and [SuspensionData] resource. It also controls steering and drive torque distribution via configurable properties.

method.name: set_steerable
method.description: If [code]true[/code], the wheels on this axle will steer in response to the vehicle's steering input.

method.name: get_steerable
method.description: Returns whether this axle is steerable.

method.name: set_drive_ratio
method.description: Sets the fraction of engine torque sent to this axle. Values range from 0.0 to 1.0. For example, 0.5 sends 50% of the torque to this axle.

method.name: get_drive_ratio
method.description: Returns the fraction of engine torque sent to this axle.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], this axle responds to steering input.
Fraction of engine torque applied to this axle (0.0 to 1.0).
